rows.grounds: restrictive particle qualifying the following practice
ritual placement of the mātṛkā syllables
fused sandhi form: kuryāt + tadrahitam; 'that' refers to the previously mentioned Rudra-Śakti accompaniment
contrastive or emphatic particle introducing an alternative
disjunctive particle marking an optional alternative

items.question: Is the mātṛkā placement valid when performed without the accompanying Rudra-Śakti elements?
premises: The preceding instruction prescribes lipinyāsa accompanied by Rudra-Śakti.
An alternative ritual procedure is introduced as an option.
The mātṛkā placement can be performed alone, devoid of that accompaniment.
items.inference: Therefore, performing only the mātṛkā placement without the Rudra-Śakti accompaniment is a permitted alternative.
uncertainties: The referent of 'that' in tadrahitaṃ is inferred from the immediately preceding context to be the Rudra-Śakti accompaniment.
items.plain_english: Alternatively, one may perform only the mātṛkā placement, without that accompanying element.
